summary.text: Spindle 3 temperature (CNC-1) reached 64.2 against the 60.0 validated limit, 4.2 over, and the alert is critical and open. Lot TM-HS12-261120-205 has 3 parts at risk. Recommend QA hold, CMM inspection, an NCR and a maintenance request.

quarantine.rationale: These 3 parts of lot TM-HS12-261120-205 were cut while Spindle 3 was outside its validated 60 °C limit. The rule's required action is a QA hold. The lot row lists 12 other parts as releasable, which QA should confirm.

cmm_inspection.scope: CMM-inspect the 3 at-risk parts of lot TM-HS12-261120-205 for stem taper and neck geometry, the risk named in the rule. No CMM results exist yet, so projected right-first-time is 76.92% (10 good of 13 started).

ncr.rationale: Parts were machined outside a validated process parameter (PS-TM-MILL-HS-003 rev C, PQ-TM-HS12-022), and the rule requires an NCR. The alert row shows NCR-20261120-170823-B19A as the id if opened.

maintenance_request.rationale: Readings rose from 57.8-58.6 to a peak of 64.2 and were still 61.0-63.1 in the last bucket. The last spindle inspection on record was 2026-09-01, which re-verified thermal compensation. Request a spindle thermal check.

risk_narrative.text: The model risk score is 87% (synthetic model spindle_risk, version 3). The largest drivers are the 5-minute spindle temperature slope (contribution 0.41) and vibration RMS (0.22). The score is an aid only; the decision rests on the measured excursion and CMM results.

steps.action: Quarantine lot TM-HS12-261120-205, covering at least the 3 at-risk parts in the disposition, until CMM results are reviewed. A qualified person signs the decision in the app.
Request CMM inspection of the at-risk parts for stem taper and neck geometry, and record the results against DHR-TM-HS12-261120-205.
Open an NCR for the Spindle 3 excursion above the 60 °C validated limit (NCR-20261120-170823-B19A is the id shown on the alert) and link it to work order WO-TM-24817.
Request a Spindle 3 inspection on CNC-1, covering cooling and thermal compensation, since temperature kept rising to 64.2 and the previous inspection was 2026-09-01.
Review the excursion against OQ-TM-CNC1-014 and PQ-TM-HS12-022 and confirm Spindle 3 is within its validated state before milling resumes.
Confirm the exact parts cut during the excursion window. The alert has no triggering part and event history was unavailable, so verify the 3-part list before deciding on the other releasable parts.
